content.short: The XRP Ledger is a public layer 1 for fast, low-cost payments, with a built-in DEX, AMM and token issuance.
content.description: The XRP Ledger has run since 2012 and reaches agreement through a federated consensus protocol rather than mining or staking. Transactions settle in a few seconds for a fraction of a cent. Features that need smart contracts on other chains are built into the protocol, including an order-book DEX, an AMM, token issuance and escrow. XRP pays fees and serves as a bridge currency between issued tokens. Community-run XRPL.org hosts documentation and client libraries for JavaScript, Python, PHP and Go, and new features such as permissioned trading and onchain lending go through amendment voting.
